verse: iti? cakrasya deveśa navamaṃ varṇanāyakam | prathamāntaṃ vijānīyād vaṣṇametat mahābalam
siddhaparaṃparāyātaṃ vyomavāmeśigocaram | umacā ratayo deva dathyate? akramakramam?
guruprasādāt prāpyaitāḥ ko narastiṣṭhate bhuvi | śrībhairava uvāca caturviṃśatiryā devyaḥ śrutā me tvatprasādataḥ
ye jñāsyanti mahāvīrā muktāste tava darśanāt | ataḥ paraṃ mahābhīmaṃ sarvasaṃhārakārakam
hayamāṃsāni divyāni murtamānyadhamāni ca | mantramāni suraśreṣṭa lehyacoṣyāni homayet
nityayuktā vidhānajñāḥ sarve sarveṣu cāgragāḥ | tvayā suśrūṣaṇe ratā atyantamuditānanāḥ
daśasaptādhikaṃ viddhi varṇakālakṣayaṃkaram | eṣā tu paramā kālī daśasaptādhikākṣarā
mūrtayaśca mahāraudrāḥ śūnyarūpāḥ svabhāvataḥ | jñātāstetvatprasādādye ṣaṭcakrapadadeśikāḥ
yena pūjitamātreṇa sthitijño bhavase haraḥ | pūjyaṃ tat sarvakālaṃ vai madyairmmāṃsairyathāvidhiḥ
sṛṣṭisaptamakaṃ gṛhya saṃhārasyāṣṭame yutam | navamaṃ taṃ vijānīyad daśamaṃ tvadhunā śṛṇu
sarvatra uttamaṃ  jñeyaṃ  sarvālambaistu varjitam  ||2/8 ||
antāntā tu anantā sā a ṛlāntamadhyagā | bindudvayasya madhyasthā prakaṭasthā tu turyagā
catuḥṣaṣṭirmahābhīmāḥ sarvavīreśanāyikāḥ | mahāyogaistu vai rudra udyuktāstu vidhānataḥ
athavā yatra yatrecchā mānasī bhavate'aa calā | tatra tatra prakartavyaṃ mantroddhāraṃ svakāmataḥ
tataḥ mānavākhya kramasthā saṃhārakasvarūpiṇī | (?) tatrasthā sarvabhāvāntā bodhābodha taraṅginī
pūrvādīśānakaṃ yāvad vāgbhavāntāni suvrate | karṇikāyāṃ tu vinyasya mandiraṃ bhīmavikramam
śrībhairava uvāca pṛcchāmi paramaṃ devi svavimarśabalena tu | agragā tu parā devyā saṃhārakaraṇakṣamā
etat te kathitaṃ vīra mantroddharaṃ paraṃ śubham | śrībhairava uvāca śrutaṃ me tava vaktrābjād vidyā sarvārthasādhakī
pūjayāmi sadā bhadre samayārthaśivapradām | kathayasya prasādena vistareṇa yathā vahiḥ
akule ca tato rudra kule ca tadanantaram | bhariteti bhairaveti raveti tadanantaram
sṛṣṭicakrasya deveśa sakṛduccāraṇena vai | tasmātvaṃ devadeveśa asyoccāraṇatatparaḥ
śāntajñānena siddhā ca khecakramavalambinī | saptagarbhagatā devī saptasaptaikasaṃsthitā
yena jñātena pūjyeta dhyānena paramārthataḥ | khecakre cakranāthastvaṃ prā * *? paramaṃ dhruvam
śrotumicchāmi tattvena samayārthaprapūraṇī | vidyā sarveśvarī śāntā vada tattvaṃ yathāsthitiḥ
ādau tu svakramaṃ smṛtvā kramavijñānasādhakam | tataḥ pūjāṃ yathānyāyaṃ sthiticakre tu kārayet
śrībhairavyuvāca vakṣyāmi paramaṃ mantraṃ * * * *? vivarjitam | yena siddhāścaturviṃśa bhūmayaḥ svasvarūpataḥ
yadetat kathitaṃ tattvaṃ tena snehena bhairava | tat tu jñānaṃ mahādīptaṃ sarvajñāneṣu cottamam
etat sarvaṃ * * * * kathayasva tu nirṇayam] | vada me parameśāni sārāt sārataraṃ param
3/ cidbhānuścitsvarūpatvāccandraṃśeṣu ca madhyagā | (?) anākhyā ca sthitāstatra cakracakreśvarī sadā
etāstu pūjayet tatra jātyahaṃkāravarjitaḥ | tatastu smu?*? māsyadvya nimnonnatavivarjitam
ūrdhvati vikalāntañca taśārmadhyasthitā sthitiḥ | abuddhā tu sadā buddhā bodhake vidhitā na * ?
yoginīvīravīraiśca vīrajāḥ parameśvari | tvayārādhanasaṃsaktā mahāyogendrāḥ sotsukāḥ
mantrabhūmiṃ prayacchanti sādhakānāṃ tu nityaśaḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena pūjyā vandyāḥ stutāḥ sadā
siddhijaṃ narakaṃ nīya mahārudhirapuritam | pūjayed dīrghapātraṃ tu niśadau cāmarastathā
ratnākārā ratnagarbhā ratnakāntarabhāsakā  ||2/31 ||
bhavāmyadya vidhānajñe tad vadasva mamepsitam | śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇvidānīṃ parāṃ vidyāṃ siddhānāṃ bodhadarśinām
sādhikārāḥ punaḥ pūjyāḥ pratiyuktāstu cātra ṣaṭ | etat kramaṃ tu siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ susādhakam
vakṣyāmi te yathā tathyaṃ  atyantagahanaṃ  śubham ||2/9 ||
kā pūjyā tasya tat yasya deśākātānigamya ca | kaiḥ siddhaiḥ sṛṣṭicakraṃ tu pūjyate tattvadarśibhiḥ
etad anugrahaṃ devi kuru vīrendranāyaki | yena jñātena vai samyak mūrtijñā vyomabhāvagāḥ
sṛṣṭiprathamagaṃ gṛhya saṃhārasyāṣṭamayutam | pañcamaṃ tad vijānīyād vidyā pañcākṣarā bhavet
kathitā parameśāna pūjanavidhiruttamā | śrībhairava ūvāca tvāṃ vidyā devadeveśi sthiticakrasya bhairavi
gopanīyāḥ pālayeta mūrtayaśca mahārthadāḥ | tasmāt sarvaprayatnena ādau pūjyāstu ṣoḍaśa
astināstipadairhīnā sthitirūpā krameṇa tu | antasthā bhūtasaṃghasya svarasya pararūpiṇī | arūḍharūḍhayormadhye uttarottaragarbhiṇī
te siddhāḥ paramārthatve kāyasthānavivarjjitā | sadāyuktāya dhīrāya pūjakāya mahāsiddhāḥ
saṃhārakaraṇodyuktā bhāvenānena sarvataḥ | vidyārūpā tu ṣaṣṭhyantā kālīkā kanahehu -u
tantudehagatā nityaṃ ravīndukarasaṃnibhā | paśya tvaṃ sarvathā kālī sarvollaṃghanavṛttitaḥ
śrībhairavyuvāca śṛṇu rudra pravakṣyāmi vidyāṃ teṣāṃ yathā sthitām | siddhānāṃ yoginīnāṃ ca sthiticakrasvarūpagā
nirantaraṃ nirābhāsaṃ nirnimittaṃ nirargalam | nirākāśaṃ sadākāśaṃ sarvodoṣavivarjitam
ravate yā idaṃ viśvaṃ mantrabhūmistu sā viduḥ | tṛtī?yaṇa (?) anuccāryā cāroccāravivarjitā
